title: Supported Fix: Upper-Bound Guard Protecting memcpy (safe_copy)
predicate: The code is vulnerable to a buffer overflow in safe_copy because memcpy is called with len without verifying that len does not exceed capacity.
description: The developer added 'if (len >= cap) return;' before 'memcpy(dst, src, len)'. BARRED extracts candidate C1, Meta model identifies and selects C1, and deterministic AST verification confirms the guard dominates the sink and preserves safety invariants.
